text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking toward the trainer's office,
I spotted Victoire Pisa with a student who
seemed to be her friend.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... is that what happened?
A falling-out with your roommate...

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, yeah... I want to make up with her,
but whenever I try to talk to her,
she totally ignores me...!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely at my wit's end!
Pisa, will you come stress-eat with me?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. ...Oh,
why don't we go to the cafe in front of the
station?
Their famous towering fruit parfait...
I've actually been curious about it for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So please,
take your time and tell me all about it.
We'll find a solution together.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
Pisaaa...! You're just so sweet.
I can't help but want to lean on you...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Go right ahead.
I'll always be here waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa would surely stay right by
her friend's side
until her spirits lifted.
It was a sight I'd grown quite used to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all,
wanting to support someone like her
was the very reason I became her
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later, back in the trainer's office,
as I sat before my PC
powering through a mountain of backlog—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I wanted to discuss tomorrow's training—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I'm sorry. You look quite busy.
Should I come back later?
choice_data_list: No, it's fine! I'll be done in a s...
No, don't worry! I'll be done in a...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Please don't rush on my account.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear... this plug is coming loose...
That could be dangerous...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...There we go.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Oh, this one too!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's connect this properly.
So it won't come apart ever again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The monitor blacks out.
The wiring short-circuited!
I rush over to her in a panic.
choice_data_list: Are you okay!? Did you get hurt!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine.
I'm so sorry, this is all my fault—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
What about the computer?
Is your work data safe...!?
choice_data_list: Never mind that, let's get you to ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I inspect every inch of her hands.
Looking for any cuts, any burns—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, really, I'm okay...!
More importantly, your work data—
choice_data_list: I can redo the work anytime. More ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After checking over and over again...
It seemed she truly hadn't suffered any
injuries.
choice_data_list: Not a scratch... it seems. Thank g...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had been careless.
I knew she had a habit of wanting to connect
everything,
yet I left unused cables lying around...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry.
Causing a mess like this...
and making you worry so much...
choice_data_list: It's fine. As long as you're safe,...
It's okay. As long as you're unhar...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer......

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Your face shows such heartfelt relief...
Ah, truly... Trainer,
you care so much for me...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...So warm. Your feelings, your gaze...
They always, without fail,
gently envelop me...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you always take my hand...
as if inviting me right into the center of
the circle...—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...Say, Trainer.
I want to know you even better...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I want to bring you more,
and even more happiness—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...No.
It's nothing at all—
